AFFIDAVIT OF JORDAN EXAMPLE, CHILD PROTECTION WORKER
Court File No. FC-99-0001 (fictional)
Page one: I am employed by the Fictional Valley Children's Aid Society.
On March 3, 2026 I received a call from an anonymous neighbour.

Page two: The caller reported that the child Riley Sample was left alone.
On March 5, 2026 I attended the home. The home was clean and food was present.
I did not personally observe the child unsupervised.

Page three: The mother, Casey Sample, stated she was at work until 6 p.m.
No corroborating statement from the neighbour was obtained.
Sworn before me on March 10, 2026.
